evals.prompt: We are in the middle of an ECS Fargate Blue/Green deployment (`d-A1B2C3D4E`) behind an Application Load Balancer where production traffic is on `:443` and the replacement task set (`GREEN`) is mounted on test listener `:8443` before traffic shifting. Design the Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 verification sequence to validate the `:8443` replacement task set using CloudWatch Synthetics canary `checkout-smoke-canary` and Golden Signal metrics, and show the exact rollback command if `:8443` fails.
evals.expected_output: Details verifying the GREEN Target Group health (`elbv2:DescribeTargetHealth` == `healthy`, `UnHealthyHostCount == 0`) and ECS task readiness (`runningCount == desiredCount`), running `checkout-smoke-canary` against `:8443` (`synthetics:StartCanary` after confirmation + polling `synthetics:GetCanaryRuns` for `Status.State == PASSED`), verifying 15-minute Golden Signals (`HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count == 0`, `p99` latency, zero new alarms, zero new `ERROR`/`FATAL` logs), and triggering `aws deploy stop-deployment --deployment-id d-A1B2C3D4E --auto-rollback-enabled` if any check fails.
expectations: Verifies Stage 1 target health on the replacement (`GREEN`) target group (`describe-target-health` reporting all targets `healthy` and `UnHealthyHostCount == 0`) and ECS task count parity (`runningCount == desiredCount`)

Details Stage 2 execution of CloudWatch Synthetics canary `checkout-smoke-canary` against the `:8443` test listener (`aws synthetics start-canary --name checkout-smoke-canary` gated by user confirmation, then polling `aws synthetics get-canary-runs --name checkout-smoke-canary` until `Status.State` is `PASSED` or `FAILED`)

Details Stage 3 Golden Signal assertions over the bake window (`HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count == 0`, `TargetResponseTime` `p99` within SLO, zero firing alarms in `get_active_alarms`, and Logs Insights exception check)
Provides the exact Stage 4 abort/rollback command: `aws deploy stop-deployment --deployment-id d-A1B2C3D4E --auto-rollback-enabled` gated by `aws-mutation-gate.py`

evals.prompt: We just deployed a new version (`Version: 18`) of our REST API backed by AWS Lambda (`orders-api`, `rest-api-id: a1b2c3d4e5`, `resource-id: r9z8y7`, using `LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes`).
